observations: Photo 0 shows the retail box for an IWIN ENERGY rechargeable wall fan.
The box specifies a 16-inch fan size and a 12AH lithium battery.
Features listed on the box include 9 speeds, AC/DC operation, a brushless motor, and a remote control.
The box mentions a working time of 5 to 48 hours.
The actual fan is not visible; only the packaging is shown in a shop-like environment.

claims.evidence: The box appears new, but the contents are not shown to confirm condition.
The wattage is not visible on the front of the box in photo 0.

risks.risk: The box may be empty or contain a different, used, or damaged unit.
risks.proof: A photo of the actual fan outside of the box.
risks.if_unproven: as a missing or damaged item

risks.risk: The lithium battery may be degraded or non-functional despite being 'new'.
risks.proof: A video of the fan running on battery power for at least 10 minutes.

risks.risk: The motor or electronic controls (including the remote) may be defective.
risks.proof: A video showing the fan operating through all 9 speeds using the remote.

proof_requests: Photo of the fan out of the box to confirm condition and model.
Video of the fan operating on battery power.
Photo of the technical specification sticker on the fan itself to verify wattage and battery specs.
response.reason: The brand and key specifications are clearly legible on the retail packaging, allowing for a valuation based on the worst-case condition of the contents.
